title: Implement dlt.py — DLT template ID validation
description: Implement validate_dlt_template_id() as specified in PRD Section 3.7. Validates TRAI DLT format (10-19 digit numeric string).

title: Implement encryption.py — AES-256-GCM field encryption + Fernet transport
description: Implement encrypt_field/decrypt_field (AES-256-GCM with v1: prefix for key rotation) and encrypt_for_transport/decrypt_from_transport (Fernet for webhook PII transit) as specified in PRD Section 3.2. Include tests for round-trip, v1 prefix verification, and transport key round-trip.

title: CLAUDE.md + README.md + pip install verification
description: Create CLAUDE.md with dev commands and architecture. Update README.md with usage examples. Verify package installs via pip install -e . and pip install git+https://github.com/spatiamed/spatiamed-common.git@v0.1.0. Verify all imports work: from sm_common.phone import hash_phone, etc.

title: Implement gupshup.py — WhatsApp Business API client (Gupshup)
description: Implement GupshupConfig dataclass and GupshupClient with send_template() and send_session_message() methods as specified in PRD Section 3.4. Async httpx client, supports tenant-specific app_name override, prepends 91 to normalized phone numbers.

title: Implement msg91.py — SMS API client (MSG91)
description: Implement MSG91Config dataclass and MSG91Client with send_sms() method as specified in PRD Section 3.5. Async httpx client, DLT-registered templates only, 6-char sender ID.

title: Implement truecaller.py — Truecaller Business caller ID registration
description: Implement TruecallerConfig dataclass and TruecallerClient with register_numbers() method as specified in PRD Section 3.6. Register hospital DIDs with Truecaller for verified caller ID display.

title: Project scaffolding: pyproject.toml, sm_common package structure, test setup
description: Set up the base project structure as defined in PRD Section 2 and 5. Create pyproject.toml with dependencies (cryptography>=46.0, httpx>=0.27, pytz>=2024.1), dev deps (pytest>=8.0, pytest-asyncio>=0.24), sm_common/__init__.py with version, and tests/ directory.

title: Implement phone.py — phone normalization + hashing
description: Implement normalize_phone() and hash_phone() as specified in PRD Section 3.1. Critical contract: hash_phone('+91 98765 43210', salt) == hash_phone('9876543210', salt). Handles +91, 91, 0 prefixes, spaces, dashes. Validates 10-digit Indian mobile (starts 6-9). Include tests in test_phone.py covering all formats and deterministic hashing.

title: Implement nmc_guardrails.py — NMC advertising content checker
description: Implement NMCViolation dataclass, NMC_RULES dict, check_content(), and has_blocking_violation() as specified in PRD Section 3.9. Rules: block superlative claims, guaranteed outcomes, misleading testimonials; warn on pricing inducements. Tests: 'best doctor'→blocked, 'experienced doctor'→pass.

title: Implement webhook_auth.py — HMAC-SHA256 webhook signing + verification
description: Implement sign_webhook() and verify_webhook() as specified in PRD Section 3.3. HMAC-SHA256 with timestamp-based replay protection (300s max age). Headers: X-Webhook-Signature (sha256=<hex>), X-Webhook-Timestamp. Tests: sign→verify round-trip, reject expired timestamps, reject tampered payloads.

title: Implement compliance.py — TCCCPR call timing rules
description: Implement is_within_allowed_hours() as specified in PRD Section 3.8. TCCCPR rules: calls only 9AM-9PM IST, max 1/day, max 3/week. Tests: 9AM→allowed, 9:30PM→blocked.
